title: I was a big time procrastinator, now I literally don’t understand how this app could change my focus
body:
After just the first 5mins of playing brain fm’s sounds i felt inspire, creatively fueled and most importantly focused which is something that is one of my main problems. Now I literally just went into a flow state of about 2hrs and did all my tasks that usually take 4hrs in one sitting. 

Could definitely recommend!!
author: Noah Tange

title: Best app for work and meditation!
body:
Thank you a lot for your great job Brain.fm Team!!! ❤️‍🔥😍🔥 
I am listening to your music everyday for a couple of hours and it truly boosts my brainpower! Keep going! 🏆🥰👏🏻❤️‍🔥
author: anifetise

title: A leap into your peaceful soul!
body:
I have been using BrainFM for 7 years, and it has been my GoTo remedy when stresses, tired and needing to perform, or just in need of some ME-time. 
I was skeptical, but have to admit… the brain is like an FM radio, waiting to be tuned to the right channel. This app is one of my most valuable tools to hack my brain, and shut out the clutter of our busy world.
author: Okser_JLO

title: Nice music
body: I cannot speak to whether the science works or not, but if nothing else, having a jukebox of potentially infinite ambient sounds and music is in itself a great investment for those of us who like to have *something* playing in the background while working.
author: Mad Pet

title: Good concept, sub-par execution
body: The audio is great, but the app is buggy and badly tested. It looks completely on the iPhone XR and offline mode doesn’t work.
author: opinionshaver

title: Really good!
body: This app really, really works. I would recommend it to everyone.
author: Louise Boel

title: Love ❤️
body: Use it every day, love it 😃
author: Lolle Andersen

title: Good effect but flaws in the app
body: I can't give it 5 stars even though I want to - the app has too many flaws. I can't get the cache function to work; sometimes it starts the track over when you're finished and press "Go to Home" etc. On top of that, the streaming sometimes drops out, which makes it impossible to focus or meditate. If those things could be fixed, my fifth star would be in place! :-) I really enjoy the tracks, both for focus and for meditation.
author: jrischel
